painpoints.text: The seed's probe suggested `petri check --print-graph`, but no petri binary exists and the CLI package is `petri-cli` (binary name `petri`) inside the vendored workspace — building it took two wrong `-p` selectors before `-p petri-cli` worked (~90s total, /tmp target dir). Suggestion: name the exact build line (`cd vendor/petri && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<tmp> cargo build --locked -p petri-cli`) in the FORMAT.md-facing docs or the develop scripts, so future probes don't rediscover it.

observations: `fabro validate --json` does NOT expose Graph.params["attractor.hooks"] — only diagnostics — so the seed's probe is only satisfiable through the vendored petri CLI's print-graph; that asymmetry is worth knowing when the next hooks-layer change needs proof.

The old coverage lint's semantics had to be re-derived, not ported: with a project-level hook EVERY workflow journals (23 dirs), and 15 toys would RED an all-workflows coverage demand — the rewrite covers the consumed six plus own-copy re-adds, and hard-fails on a lost project hook (the true silent-death mode).
prompt-lint's tracker census tier self-suspended this run (census unavailable: External command failed) — pre-existing fail-open behavior, exit 0, not touched by this diff.

Verification relied on live evidence beyond the recorded probe: journal records for tester (08:14:50) and evidence (08:14:52) were written after the implementer (08:14:36) removed the loop workflow's own hook copy, proving the project-layer hook fires without needing the redirected /tmp/graph-after.txt (which is unreadable post-sandbox).

The validator rewrite deliberately narrows coverage demand to the six consumed workflows plus re-declares instead of all 23 workflow dirs — correct given the project hook makes every workflow journal, and the hard project-hook presence assertion covers the silent-death mode the old check could not see.

The id='stage-journal' on the project entry changes re-add semantics from append to replace-by-id — a behavior-relevant detail that is documented in the project.toml comment and matches FORMAT.md; no deviation.
